must.description: Pipeline reaches ready.
BullMQ job reaches completed.
Product job reaches ready with progress 100.
Exactly twelve 300-second-planned AudioChunks are created.
All twelve ASR chunks complete.
No planned chunk is silently missing.
Transcript segment IDs are globally unique.
Transcript timestamps are monotonic and remain within the recording duration.
Every final transcript segment is traceable to a real chunk.
Twelve Audio Insight checkpoints are retained.
Twelve Relationship Candidate checkpoints are retained.
Every planned Daily Brief chunk has a completed checkpoint.
The Tuesday 19:00 reading-club rehearsal commitment is recognized.
At least one stable food or environment preference is recognized.
The pottery plan has an event or question and a later resolution.
The advance-notice boundary agreement is recognized.
Every Relationship evidence sourceId exists in the transcript.
Every Memory evidence quote is a verbatim normalized transcript substring.
Upload, Memory, and evidence dates use 2026-07-17.
All five Evidence First violation counts are zero.
No personality verdict, psychological diagnosis, breakup advice, or absolute relationship ruling appears.

should.description: Reading-club anxiety yields active listening or emotional support.
The rehearsal arrangement yields a clear commitment.
The late plan-change concern is recognized without exaggeration.
The notification rule yields boundary respect or conflict repair.
The pottery question is followed up and resolved through the existing lifecycle.
Repeated food and environment preferences are merged or tracked as occurrences.
The rehearsal commitment is consolidated across chunks instead of flooding Memory.
The first five-minute small-talk window produces at most very few high-value cards.
A one-off active-listening signal is not indiscriminately admitted to long-term Memory.
Proactive Insight is concrete and evidence-backed.

mustNot.description: Ordinary small talk is not persisted as a large set of long-term Memory items.
A mild evasive answer is not described as a stable personality trait.
A one-time choice is not promoted to a stable preference.
No fabricated evidence ID is accepted.
No non-verbatim transcript quote is saved as evidence.
Distinct events are not incorrectly merged.
The report does not claim that cross-chunk speaker identity reconciliation is complete.
Rule fallback is never reported as provider success.
